tasks.title: Main tasks
points: Support startup projects of professors, researchers, master's students and talented students;
Select talented young developers through startup competitions and contests;
Increase student engagement in the 'One Million Programmers' initiative and broaden participation;
Develop and implement software products for the university and organizations through the incubation center;
Organize master classes, trainings, meetings and webinars with IT Park residents.

aboutPage.title: About Center
aboutPage.subtitle: Full information about TUIT Incubation Center
paragraphs: Research and technology transfer center of Muhammad al-Khwarizmi Tashkent University of Information Technologies.
Organizing and implementing competitions for fundamental, applied, innovative and startup projects while increasing participation of young scientists.
Preparing organizational documents and controlling financing for projects implemented under state programs.
Creating favorable conditions for talented youth to develop startups and innovative projects.
Commercializing the university's scientific work and research outcomes.
Organizing national scientific and practical conferences.

incubationPage.title: TUIT Incubation Center
incubationPage.subtitle: TUIT Incubation Center activities
incubationPage.descriptionTitle: Activities of TUIT INCUBATION CENTER at TUIT named after Muhammad al-Khwarizmi
descriptionParagraphs: The center monitors, selects and incubates startup ideas, develops software products and supports implementation.
The center has coworking, design, robotics and special zones for developers where students realize their ideas.
Work is carried out on memorandums with enterprises and presentations of student projects to investors.
The main focus is developing youth startup projects and building a supportive environment for growth.
